feeds.title: PC Gamer
feeds.description: PC Gamer is the world's best-selling PC games magazine, a coveted position obtained by hiring hardcore gamers as editors. The magazine delivers hard-hitting reviews, winning game strategies, explanations for complex games technology, and news about what's next in this rapidly changing arena. Smart, irreverent, and well-connected, PC Gamer not only keeps readers 'in the know,' but also invites new computer users into world of PC games.
